analysis_result.analysis: Although the model arrived at the correct final answer (0 hidden red faces), its reasoning is fundamentally flawed. It misperceived the color and position of the red face on Cube 1 — claiming it was on top (visible) when ground truth confirms it was on the right side (hidden). This misattribution led the model to falsely conclude that the red face was visible, thereby 'justifying' the answer of 0 hidden red faces. This is not a lucky guess — it’s a case of incorrect perception and binding that coincidentally produced the right answer. The model failed to accurately interpret the spatial orientation and color mapping of the cubes, indicating a serious perception and grounding error.
